newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway issues 4-month T-bill for NOK 5.5 bln.
newsitem.headline: Norway issues 4-month T-bill for NOK 5.5 bln.

text.p: Norway's central bank, Norges Bank, said on Tuesday the Finance Ministry had issued a new four-month treasury bill, SS49, for 5.5 billion crowns, with 500 million crowns reserved for the bank.
Norges Bank announced on Friday that it would hold an ad-hoc issue of a new T-bill.
The T-bill will be issued via ordinary auction with the deadline for tenders July 10. Settlement is on July 14.
The T-bill has a nominal interest rate of four percent and matures on November 17, 1997.
